LA-2026-SB414.aiSummary: This act creates the Louisiana Medical Debt Protection Act. It caps interest on medical debt for medically necessary care at 2% a year, limits when wages or bank accounts can be garnished, and bars liens or foreclosure on a primary home or primary vehicle for that debt. It also lets the attorney general enforce the law and gives people a right to sue for harm; it took effect on June 9, 2026.

documents.label: Senate Green Sheet Digest for HB1038
Summary of Senate Amendments to HB1038

LA-2026-HB1038.aiSummary: The law changes how a marshal can appoint deputy marshals. It lets the marshal issue commissions to deputy marshals, but only with approval from the local governing authority, which must also insure approved deputies. Local governing bodies must tell the marshal each year how many commissions can be issued, and if a marshal’s area crosses into a ward, the larger local government makes that choice. It became Act No. 866 and takes effect on 01/01/2027.
